Bottom line: Prioritize immediate risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions.
plays: Review and adjust stops for SOXL, MUU, and SPAL immediately. These leveraged SELL positions are significantly down, and their current stops are ineffective.

Consider adding to PLTU. Your scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" signal (8/12) with an entry around 63.19-63.03 and stop at 62.13.
